title: PCR Preparation and Pooling with 384 Plates - Stage 1
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add water to pool plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 12 µL of water into every well of a fresh 384‑well plate using the same pipette tip for the entire plate.

steps.title: Transfer samples to pool plate
steps.instruction: Pool the four source PCR plates into the water‑filled 384‑well plate, one plate at a time, using a fresh tip for each plate and following the specified well‑mapping scheme.

substeps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, transfer 3 µL of sample from each well of PCR plate 1 (located in slot 1) to the pool plate: source wells A1, A2, B1, B2 go to destination well A1; source wells A3, A4, B3, B4 go to destination well A3; continue this pattern for the remainder of the plate.

Using a fresh tip, transfer 3 µL from each well of PCR plate 2 to the pool plate, starting the destination wells at B1 and skipping every other well (e.g., source A1 → destination B1, A2 → B3, etc.) while keeping the same source‑well grouping as for plate 1.
Using a fresh tip, transfer 3 µL from each well of PCR plate 3 to the pool plate, beginning destination wells at B1 and following the same grouping and skip‑every‑other‑well pattern.
Using a fresh tip, transfer 3 µL from each well of PCR plate 4 to the pool plate, beginning destination wells at B2 and following the same grouping and skip‑every‑other‑well pattern.
